sourceNote: PRIMARY MEASURED STUDY, read directly from the primary article (Peter Day, TCGplayer Authentication Center, for the 2022-05-27 release): more than 8,000 Astral Radiance packs opened. Their published figures: Ultra Rare 20.03% = normal V 12.77% (1 in 8), VMAX/VSTAR 3.47% (1 in 29), full-art V 2.13% (1 in 47), full-art Trainer 1.08% (1 in 93), alt-art V 0.74% (1 in 135); Secret Rare 2.05% (1 in 49) = rainbow 1.28% + gold 0.76%; Trainer Gallery 12.58%. Mapped by inspecting tier membership: ultra_rare = 20.03 - 12.77 = 7.26%; hyper_rare = 2.05%. ONE BORROWED NUMBER, STATED PLAINLY: this catalog's double_rare tier (22 cards) holds the 19 normal V PLUS 3 Radiant Pokemon (Radiant Heatran/Greninja/Hawlucha), but TCGplayer's Astral Radiance table has NO Radiant row -- this was the set that introduced Radiants and they did not break the rate out. The same Authentication Center measured Radiant at 5.01% in Lost Origin and 4.55% in Silver Tempest, the sets either side of this one with the identical Radiant slot; the midpoint 4.78% is used here, so double_rare = 12.77 + 4.78 = 17.55%. Any true value inside that measured 4.55-5.01 bracket moves double_rare by at most 0.23pp. The remaining tiers are measured directly. KNOWN CONSERVATIVE GAP: the 12.58% Trainer Gallery subset is not carried, so this set's EV is UNDERSTATED.
